direction: Conversational, like telling a friend a story over a drink. Not an announcer, not a trailer voice.
Dry humour: say the jokes straight and let them land. Don't sell them.
Questions should sound genuinely curious, not rhetorical.
About 150 to 160 words per minute, with a beat of breathing room at each chapter heading.
Read the text exactly as written. If a line doesn't work in your mouth, flag it rather than changing it.

images.style: Flat 2D cartoon illustration for a history explainer video. Simple round-headed cartoon people with small black dot eyes, expressive eyebrows and simple mouths, rounded bodies and simple rounded hands, clean medium-weight dark brown outlines, flat colours with soft cel shading. Muted earthy historical palette of ochre, olive green, brick red, slate blue and parchment cream. One clear focal point, readable silhouettes, uncluttered background, period-accurate clothing, tools and buildings.
images.suffix: Widescreen 16:9 composition with important action away from the edges. Leave document and sign surfaces blank for checked compositor overlays. No letters, numbers, pseudo-writing or invented glyphs. No watermark or border.
images.reference_note: The attached image is the style reference: match its drawing style, outline weight, flat colours, palette and paper texture exactly. Draw a new scene; do not reuse its layout, buildings or characters.
images.composition: One clear focal point and readable silhouettes against an uncluttered background. Widescreen 16:9 framing with the main action kept away from the edges, as a full-bleed illustration that runs to every edge.
images.cast_rule: Every person in the scene wears clothing of the period in muted colours and has a natural number of arms, hands and fingers.
images.no_orange: Nobody in the scene wears orange.
images.text_rule: Leave document and sign surfaces blank. All writing is added later as checked compositor overlays.
images.avoid: modern clothing or objects, labels, captions, watermarks, signatures, photorealism, 3D rendering
images.pose_background: a plain, flat, evenly lit chroma-key green background (#00B140) filling the whole frame, with no shadow, no floor and no gradient

characters.Visitor: The Visitor is a modern man in his late twenties with an adult face and build: a defined jaw, adult proportions about four heads tall, messy dark brown hair, a bright orange hoodie, blue jeans and white sneakers. He is the only person in modern clothes, and he must match the attached Visitor reference sheet exactly.
